notes.general_comments: General comments AS Level Chemistry requires candidates to know a certain amount of factual chemistry, to understand some basic concepts, and to be able to apply these concepts. This paper tested each of these skills and there were some pleasing answers. Examiners felt the overall standard achieved by candidates was similar to that reached last year. For many candidates their poorest answers were to Questions 1 and 2 where they struggled with various aspects of chemical bonding and reaction mechanisms/pathways.
